feature_name: Conditional Expert Mode for Body Fields
description: Implement conditional expert mode availability for body fields in service forms. The expert mode toggle should be available for JSON and Raw body types but disabled for HTML body types to prevent formula injection vulnerabilities.
functional_requirements: In the HTTP request service form, ensure the expert mode toggle remains available for both JSON and Raw body type fields
In the email service form, disable the expert mode toggle specifically for HTML body type fields
Maintain existing expert mode functionality for all other body types and form fields
Ensure the UI clearly indicates when expert mode is unavailable (grayed out or disabled state)
